PorchLyte (Agent Social Haus) is a DIY set of AI tools and a monthly content library for real estate agents. For $97/month, you get AI writing tools, a monthly content calendar with written captions, Canva templates, reel scripts, and live calls and training. But you still brand the templates and schedule and post everything yourself. There is no video editing, no posting service, and no client dashboard.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
